meta.title: ARNA: live voice translation for events
meta.description: ARNA translates a live speaker into ten languages. Listeners pick their language and follow by audio or subtitles on their phone. Join the pilot.

title: Speak once.
Everyone understands.
hero.subtitle: ARNA translates a live speaker into ten languages. Listeners follow by audio or subtitles on their own phone.

how.title: Four steps from the stage to your phone

steps.title: Join the event
steps.text: Scan the organizer's QR code or open the link.

steps.title: Choose a language
steps.text: Pick one of ten languages. You can switch at any moment.

steps.title: Confirm the voice
steps.text: ARNA recognizes the speaker's voice, so the translation always follows the right person.

steps.title: Listen and read
steps.text: Hear the translation, read the subtitles and get a short summary at the end.

demo.title: Try it right in your browser
demo.text: Walk through the listener's screen: choose a language, confirm the voice and follow the translation.
demo.notice: This is a scripted demonstration with prepared text. Real AI translation comes in the next phase.

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hint: The speaker will be translated into this language.

voice.title: Is this the speaker's voice?
voice.hint: ARNA is listening to the stage.
voice.speaker: Main speaker

live.sameLang: The speaker is talking in your language, so no translation is needed.
live.bothOff: Turn on audio or subtitles to follow the speaker.

items.title: Voice recognition
items.text: ARNA recognizes who is speaking and keeps the translation attached to the right voice, even in panels and Q&A.

items.title: Multilingual translation
items.text: Ten languages from day one. The speaker speaks once, and every listener follows in their own language.

items.title: Auto-summary
items.text: When the session ends, each listener gets a short summary with the key points in their language.

items.title: Event content
items.text: Transcripts and summaries stay available after the event.

items.title: Referral program
items.text: Share your personal link with other organizers and receive a bonus for their first event.

items.title: Background mode
items.text: Lock the screen or switch apps, and the translated audio keeps playing without interruption.

cases.title: Made for every kind of gathering

items.title: Universities
items.text: Lectures and conferences where students and guest professors speak different languages.

items.title: Forums
items.text: International forums and congresses: one stage, every delegate in their own language.

items.title: Weddings
items.text: A toi with guests from several countries: toasts and blessings understood by everyone.

items.title: Companies
items.text: Town halls and meetings with international teams and partners.

items.title: Trainers
items.text: Workshops and courses for groups that do not share one language.
